entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Windows app does not respond to Ctrl+C when launched from dotnet CLI #52473
  • `dotnet --debug` switch no longer works #52471
  • AnalysisLevel latest not using the correct set of rules #52467
  • [WebToolsE2E][Green] Right click BlazorApp ~ WebAssembly project in solution explorer and select "Open In Integrated Terminal", type "dotnet watch", An unexpected error occurred"System.IO.IOException: The configured user limit (128) ..." #52464
  • EndToEnd.Tests.GivenDotNetLinuxInstallers is not behaving as intended #52459
  • Replace realpath P/Invoke with File.ResolveLinkTarget #52458
  • [release/10.0.2xx] Missing workload packages #52457
  • dotnet publish crashes (SIGBUS) when PublishSingleFile=true on Linux #52445
  • Re-enable template test legs once the aspnet templates are fixed #52442

Closed

  • dotnet --info output has newline issue when 10.0.2 installed via Visual Studio 2026 #52472
  • 10.0.2 GitHub Release is missing #52465
  • `GivenDotnetPackageAdd` `noRestore=false` fails to work with package source mapping #52439
